rules.rule: an entity held by two or more systems that no system claims with "owns: true", or a field held by two or more systems that no system claims and the owner of its entity does not hold
an entity that two or more systems claim with "owns: true", or a field that two or more systems name in "owns"

a flow, or the return way of a two-way flow, that carries a field held by both its ends whose one owner is not the system it comes from, unless the flow has an exception with a reason that is not empty or one of "tbd", "tba", "todo"
a field with one owner, held by another system that is not the target of any flow from the owner that carries the field
a flow whose source or target is not a system of the map, whose entity no system holds or one of its ends does not hold, or whose fields one of its ends does not hold
a field that flows from one system to another and back, through a two-way flow or two one-way flows, with no approved exception among them
a system whose team or contact is missing, empty or a value that names no one
